title: Subsystem Registry Consistency Hotfix
name: Subsystem Registry Consistency Hotfix
summary: Standardizes subsystem naming and version metadata through a central Subsystem Registry and adds permanent consistency checks to prevent UI, manifest and runtime labels from drifting apart.
changes: Added Subsystem Registry v1.0.0 as the single source of truth for subsystem display names, IDs, versions, owners and descriptions.
Standardized the official name Project Brain across Platform Intelligence and removed UI-owned subsystem metadata.
Platform Intelligence version cards are now rendered from the central registry.
Diagnostics Framework v1.3.0 verifies registry and manifest consistency.
Platform Contracts v1.1.0 adds a permanent subsystem metadata regression check.
Project Brain v1.0.1 records the naming and metadata contract.
